text: dsh-material-file-icons 为 DSH 网页文件树添加 Material 风格文件和文件夹图标。主机端按精确路由提供并缓存 SVG，客户端样式按常见文件类型、目录名称及开合状态映射对应图标，并观察文件树变化更新目录状态，帮助用户快速辨认项目内容，让文件树更易读。无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-material-file-icons adds Material-style icons to the DSH web file tree. The host serves and caches SVGs by exact route. Client styles map common file types and named folders to icons, distinguish open folders, and observe tree changes. No API keys or external services are required.
想让 DSH 网页文件树里的不同文件类型显示不同图标。
项目目录展开时，能不能用另一种文件夹图标区分开合状态？
I want recognizable icons for source files and folders in the DSH web explorer.
dsh-material-file-icons 的功能「文件类型图标」：为文件树中的常见源码、配置、文档和媒体扩展名显示对应 SVG 图标。客户端样式按文件名后缀映射图标，图标资源由主机端精确路由提供。
dsh-material-file-icons 的功能「文件夹图标」：为命名目录显示相应文件夹图标，并依据后续行缩进推断目录是否展开，以切换开合图标。客户端观察文件树变化并更新目录属性。

dsh-material-file-icons README · dsh-material-file-icons：Material Icon Theme-style file & folder icons for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) web GUI file explorer (`dsh-better-sidebar`).

dsh-material-file-icons README · What you get：- **~350 authentic SVGs** from [`PKief/vscode-material-icon-theme`](https://github.com/PKief/vscode-material-icon-theme) (MIT) and the shadcn glyph from [`vscode-icons/vscode-icons`](https://github.com/vscode-icons/vscode-icons)
- **90+ file types**: languages, frameworks, configs, media, archives…
- **Filename-specific icons**: `component.json` / `components.json` → theme-aware shadcn logo, `tsconfig.json`, `jest.config.*`, `.editorconfig`, `nest-cli.json`, …
- **~130 named folder families** (`src`, `components`, `__tests__`, `.github`, `node_modules`, …) with **authentic open/closed variants**

dsh-material-file-icons README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:sarfarazstark/dsh-material-file-icons
```

Then restart DeepSeek Harness Desktop. That's it — no other steps.

dsh-material-file-icons README · How it works：- The host half serves every SVG over exact `/material-icons/*.svg` routes (in-memory cache).
- The client half injects one stylesheet and runs a lightweight `MutationObserver` that tags explorer directory rows with `data-dir` (folder name) and `data-open` attributes. Pure CSS maps those to icons — **no patching of dsh-better-sidebar required**.

dsh-material-file-icons README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-material-file-icons
```

dsh-material-file-icons README · Credits：Icon artwork belongs to the upstream projects: [Material Icon Theme](https://github.com/PKief/vscode-material-icon-theme) (MIT) and [vscode-icons](https://github.com/vscode-icons/vscode-icons). This plugin only redistributes their SVG assets for use inside DSH.
